scriptData.label: @effect.name
Roll to remove Stunned

description.label: Description
description.value:
Everyone witnessing your calamity winces as your foe lands one in a most uncomfortable region, which also happens to be the home of several large blood vessels, adding severe bleeding to your misfortune.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and @Condition[Stunned] (3). If male, you may find yourself having problems procreating.
